label: Shopee Ads
terms_note: Shopee Open Platform developer account (partner_id / partner_key, HMAC-SHA256 signed calls, shop authorization → access_token) plus an Ads permission granted by Shopee Partner Support; region availability varies. Rate limits per Open Platform policy (not read). Free.

discovery.auth: hmac (Shopee Open Platform partner_id + partner_key signature + shop access_token)
sdks: https://github.com/congminh1254/shopee-sdk (community TypeScript SDK with an ads manager)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Shopee Open API v2 — Ads module, permissioned).
auth: 1. Register on open.shopee.com as a developer; create an app → `partner_id` + `partner_key`; the seller authorizes the shop → `access_token` (+ refresh).
2. Ask Shopee Partner Support to enable the Ads permission for the app (region-dependent).
3. Sign every call: `sign = HMAC-SHA256(partner_key, partner_id + path + timestamp + access_token + shop_id)`; JSON bodies; dates `DD-MM-YYYY`; unique `reference_id` on create/edit.

endpoints.purpose: create / edit ads with budget, bidding, ROAS
endpoints.notes: reference_id, item_id, budget, start_date, end_date, bidding_method, roas_target, keywords[]

reference.limits: - Open Platform rate limits per partner (TODO(verify)); Ads permission by application; regional availability; free.
mcp_sdk: Community: congminh1254/shopee-sdk (TypeScript). Official docs module=105 on open.shopee.com.

config_fields.name: partner_id
config_fields.help: partner_id of your Shopee Open Platform app (Console > App).

config_fields.name: shop_id
config_fields.help: shop_id of the authorised shop (returned in the authorisation redirect).

fields.name: partner_key
fields.help: partner_key (live key) of the Shopee Open Platform app with the Ads (AMS/Ads) API permission; signs the token refresh and every shop call (HMAC-SHA256). Never sent on the wire.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: refresh_token from GetAccessToken (/api/v2/auth/token/get) after the shop authorised the app (https://open.shopee.com/developer-guide/20). Valid 30 days and rotated on every refresh; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

adapter.terms: Shopee Open Platform v2 Ads API (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.ads.get_total_balance?module=127&type=1): shop-level calls to https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ads/… carry partner_id, shop_id, timestamp, access_token and sign = HMAC-SHA256(partner_key, partner_id + api path + timestamp + access_token + shop_id); the 4-hour access_token is renewed with the signed v2.public.refresh_access_token (POST /api/v2/auth/access_token/get), which rotates the refresh token. Answers {error ('' = success), message, warning, request_id, response}. Needs an app with Ads permission authorised by the shop.

me.note: v2.ads.get_total_balance: the shop's real-time ads credit (response.total_balance, paid plus free credits, and data_timestamp).

list_campaigns.note: v2.ads.get_product_level_campaign_id_list (ad_type all, offset/limit; response.has_next_page): the shop's product campaign ids with ad_type auto|manual only — `name` carries that ad_type because the list returns no names. Names, campaign_status (ongoing, scheduled, ended, paused, deleted, closed), campaign_budget and duration come from v2.ads.get_product_level_campaign_setting_info (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.ads.get_product_level_campaign_setting_info?module=127&type=1, up to 100 ids). account_id and status are not sent (the shop_id selects the shop).

get_report.note: v2.ads.get_all_cpc_ads_daily_performance (start_date/end_date as DD-MM-YYYY): shop-level CPC ads performance per day — impression, clicks, ctr, expense, direct/broad orders, conversions, items sold and GMV, cost_per_conversion, direct_roas (all in raw). campaign_id is not applied: per-campaign days come from v2.ads.get_product_campaign_daily_performance (https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.ads.get_product_campaign_daily_performance?module=127&type=1).

update_budget.note: v2.ads.edit_manual_product_ads with edit_action change_budget sets the campaign budget (campaign_budget in the shop currency; 0 = unlimited) of a manual-selection product campaign; auto product ads use v2.ads.edit_auto_product_ads, which is 'coming offline soon'. This spends money. currency is ignored (the shop's currency applies).

pause_resume.note: v2.ads.edit_manual_product_ads with edit_action pause | resume (other actions: start, stop, delete, change_budget, change_duration, …) for a manual-selection product campaign. Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.list_accounts: The Ads API is shop-scoped: every call carries one shop_id and the Ads module has no account listing (v2.ads.* list: get_total_balance, get_shop_toggle_info, performance, product campaign and GMS calls; https://open.shopee.com/documents/v2/v2.ads.get_total_balance?module=127&type=1).

evidence: host partner.shopeemobile.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
